text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Did you see me cross the finish line?!
Were you
amazed?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe! That's what I like to hear!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But I really wanted to do the Double
Crown
peace sign in the winner's circle...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio's disappointment at not
being able to
make it to Symboli
Rudolf's level shows through.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, I need to pull myself together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sure, I feel super angry I can't become a
Triple
Crown champion...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But staying down in the dumps isn't
gonna help
me beat Prez! I have to keep
walking forward to
reach her!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So I gotta move right on and focus on
the next
race! It's the last of the
Classics...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll get straight back to training
tomorrow!
choice_data_list_en: Let's take on the 'Kikuka Sho' with everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hehe... Seems like I'm a bit tired. My
foot's
cramping.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
choice_data_list: まずはゆっくり休もう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our push for the last Crown race, the
Kikuka Sho,
starts now!
